engineering.details: Authoritative continuity/Reynolds/Darcy-Weisbach model is unchanged and renderer consumes its outputs without duplicate hydraulic calculations.

pedagogy.details: Four-step lesson connects continuity, Reynolds regime, friction factor/head loss, and reversal interpretation with a corresponding spatial consequence.

functionality.details: Source review covers host-scene construction, parameter mutation, deterministic update(time), reset, snapshot, resize validation, and idempotent disposal.

animation.details: Flow tracers and arrow direction are deterministic from absolute host time; animation is purposeful and explicitly display-scaled.

spatial3d.details: Real Three.js scene source is implemented with recognizable pipe geometry, depth, lighting hooks, camera presets and spatial head-loss cues; rendered comparison could not be observed in this connector-only run.

accessibility.details: Demo preserves keyboard buttons, step text, metrics and reduced-motion behavior; browser/assistive-technology execution remains pending.

visual.details: Surveying-style composition, focus mode, responsive overlays and camera presets are implemented in source; no fabricated rendered pass is claimed.

reuse.details: Runtime-v1 host scene/time ownership is preserved; exact Three.js peer version is declared; owned GPU resources are disposed.

unresolvedBlockers: Independent browser/WebGL rendering and surveying-reference visual comparison are still required before readiness/public approval.
